name: Project templates
description: Create new projects from templates in Git repositories

sources.label: Template sources
sources.help: Git repositories with templates, as git+https://, git+ssh:// or git+file:// addresses. Each template is a folder with a template.json. An earlier source wins when two templates share an ID. Private repositories use the access Git itself has, e.g. the token of a Git host.

searchPaths.label: Folders with templates
searchPaths.help: Folders of a source whose sub-folders are templates, relative to the root of the repository. A dot is the root itself.

projectRoot.label: Project folder
projectRoot.help: New projects are created as sub-folders of this folder.

cacheDir.label: Storage for fetched sources
cacheDir.help: One shallow copy per source. Fetch templates removes copies of sources that are no longer configured.

name.label: Project name
name.help: Name of the new folder in the project folder.

values.label: Template parameters
values.help: Values of the parameters the template declares, by key. They replace the {{key}} placeholders in the files the template marks for rendering.

hooks.label: Run template commands

again.label: Run again
again.help: Run the commands although they ran for this project before.

hooks.confirm: The commands the template lists under hooks.postCreate run in the project folder with the rights of the user. The dry run lists every command.
